error[ZBX-E0013]: mounts that cannot go together
  while  reading the command line
  cause  --tmpfs '/scratch/in': that path is inside, or holds, another mount's
         path
  arg    /scratch/in
  fix    give each mount a path of its own, or drop one
  more   zbx explain E0013
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0013.html
